name: ガラス製品

pages.text: The most simple glass products are $(thing)Glass Panes$() and $(thing)Glass Blocks$(). In order to craft them, you must start with a $(l:crafting/glassworking#blowpipe)Blowpipe$() with a $(thing)Glass Batch$(), and then perform a $(thing)Pour$().$(br)$(li)$(bold)Table Pours$() are used to create $(thing)Glass Panes$()$(li)$(bold)Basin Pours$() are used to create $(thing)Glass Blocks$()

ガラスは注ぐ前に$(thing)染める$()こともでき、これにより色付きガラスを作成できます。色はガラスバッチの種類と、追加された粉末に依存します。$(br2)各種類の$(thing)ガラスバッチ$()は、それぞれ異なる自然なガラスの色を持っています。$(thing)シリカ$()ガラスバッチは多くの色に、$(thing)かんらん$()と$(thing)火山$()ガラスは比較的少ない色に染められます。

$(thing)Glass Panes$() are made with a $(thing)Table Pour$(). A pouring table is made by placing up to sixteen $(thing)Brass Plated Blocks$() in a continuous area.$(br2) 1. Add a $(l:crafting/glassworking)Glass Batch$() to a $(thing)Blowpipe$().$(br) 2. Heat the blowpipe to $(4)$(bold)Faint Red$().$(br) 3. $()$(item)$(k:key.use)$() the $(thing)Blowpipe$() on the top of the table.$(br) 4. Finally $(item)$(k:key.use)$() with a $(l:crafting/glassworking#paddle)Paddle$() to flatten the glass.
pages.title: テーブルに注ぐ

pages.text: Once the glass is cooled, it can be broken with a $(l:crafting/glassworking#saw)Gem Saw$() to obtain.

$(thing)Glass Blocks$() are made with a $(thing)Basin Pour$(). A basin is made by surrounding all sides of an air block except the top with $(thing)Brass Plated Blocks$().$(br2) 1. Add a $(l:crafting/glassworking)Glass Batch$() to a $(thing)Blowpipe$().$(br) 2. Heat the blowpipe to $(4)$(bold)Faint Red$().$(br) 3. $(item)$(k:key.use)$() the $(thing)Blowpipe$() on the top of the table.
pages.title: 穴に注ぐ

pages.text: Once the glass is cooled, it can be broken with a $(l:crafting/glassworking#saw)Gem Saw$() to obtain.

Glass has a natural color based on the type of $(l:crafting/glassworking)Glass Batch$() that was used. Other colors can be made using a $(l:food/bowls)Bowl$().$(br2)To use, place the $(l:food/bowls)Bowl$() on the ground, then $(item)$(k:key.use)$() the required $(thing)Powder$(). Before $(thing)Pouring$(), use the $(thing)Blowpipe$() on the bowl to add the powder to the batch.
pages.title: ガラスの染色

pages.text: $(thing)ランタンガラス$()は$(l:mechanics/lamps)ランタン$()を作るために必要な部品です。
$(l:food/jarring)Jars$() are also made from blown glass, but only silica or hematitic glass.
$(thing)ガラス瓶$()も作ることができます。ガラス瓶の品質は、使用されるガラスの種類によって異なります。
$(thing)レンズ$()は、望遠鏡、コンパス、日照センサーの製作に使用されます。
